title: How I use LLMs to learn complex topics
summary:
The author dislikes typical LLM explanations for being too simplistic or overly emoji-laden. Instead, they use LLMs to create interactive, low-poly simulations—like games—to learn complex topics effectively. Their workflow involves: 1) having an LLM build foundational knowledge about a topic, 2) reviewing that knowledge for accuracy, 3) asking it to generate a Rollercoaster Tycoon-style animation with UX considerations (responsive design, playback controls), and 4) pushing it to a GitHub Pages site.

A key example is ChipTycoon, which visualizes chip manufacturing from raw sand to a finished chip delivered to a data center. A visible cart tracks the process, showing how the product changes at each stage. While low-poly graphics require some imagination, the simulation is designed to be accurate and hallucination-free.

To enhance realism, the author suggests converting real images into 3D objects to replace the low-poly representations. They also recommend adding interactive challenges—such as questions about previous steps or intuitive puzzles—to boost knowledge retention.

The author has applied this method to other topics, including rocket engine manufacturing, how LLMs work, F1 engine construction, and EUV machine production.

一个关键示例是ChipTycoon，它将芯片制造过程从原始沙子到成品芯片交付到数据中心的全过程可视化。一个可见的推车跟踪整个过程，展示产品在每个阶段的变化。虽然低多边形图形需要一些想象力，但该模拟设计为准确且无幻觉的。

为了增强真实感，作者建议将真实图像转换为3D对象，以替代低多边形表示。他们还建议添加交互式挑战——例如关于先前步骤的问题或直观的谜题——以提高知识留存率。

title: Mea Culpa – Dark Hours
summary:
The author launched a web project called **Dark Hours**, a utility for viewing what’s visible in the night sky. A developer of an existing app, **DarkHours.app**, pointed out on Bluesky that the projects were strikingly similar—including the name. After investigating, the author realized their app, built largely with **Claude**, closely mirrored the open-source project and even reproduced a bug the original developer had already fixed.

As a result, the author:
- Redirected the **Dark Hours domain** to the original developer’s site.
- Canceled plans for a related iOS app.
- Gave full credit to the original developer and encouraged users to use the real, open-source version.

The author also apologized for relying irresponsibly on AI without realizing the project already existed. While they had never seen DarkHours.app before, they accepted responsibility for publishing something too similar. Going forward, they will not use AI in that way to build web projects again, and on iOS they will only use AI for questions and debugging—not for creating entire apps.

title: OpenChamber: An Agentic Development Environment
summary:
OpenChamber is an open-source, agentic development environment built on the OpenCode SDK. It is designed to reduce tab-hopping and keep developers moving forward steadily.

Key features include:

- **Session Goals**: Agents keep working toward a defined finish line across multiple turns, even if the app is closed.
- **Multi-run & Fusion**: Run one task across up to five models, keep the best result, or fuse the strongest parts.
- **Changes Walkthrough**: Large diffs are grouped into ordered, understandable steps.
- **Preview**: Point at an element in a running app and send the agent all relevant context behind it.
- **Issue to PR**: Start from a GitHub issue or PR, send failed checks back, and merge without leaving the environment.
- **Scheduled Work**: Run prompts on cron schedules, optionally combined with Session Goals.

The workspace is available everywhere: native desktop apps for macOS, Windows, and Linux; browser/PWA/mobile access; and a VS Code extension. It supports project actions, SSH forwarding, local URLs, background notifications, and a UI password for secure public browser access.

Privacy is a major focus: code, prompts, diffs, and session content stay on the user’s machine and are not collected. Remote access can be protected with a password, revocable tunnels, and a Private Relay option that pairs devices via QR code with end-to-end encryption and no open ports. Because OpenChamber is open source, its privacy model is inspectable.

OpenChamber is free to use. It runs on the OpenCode SDK, installable via `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash`. More details are available in its documentation.

title: Cool URIs Don't Change (1998)
summary:
**Summary: "Cool URIs Don't Change" (1998) by Tim Berners-Lee**

In this influential essay, Tim Berners-Lee argues that a well-designed URL should be permanent and stable. He asserts that "cool URIs don't change" — once you publish a link, it should remain valid indefinitely. Changing URLs breaks the Web by creating dead links, losing bookmarks, and undermining trust.

Berners-Lee offers key design principles for durable URIs:
- **Keep URLs simple and meaningful** so they are easy to remember, guess, and quote.
- **Avoid unnecessary details** like file extensions, version numbers, or implementation-specific markers (e.g., `.asp`, `v2.0`). These are irrelevant to content and may become obsolete.
- **Don't embed transient information** such as dates, company names, or product names that may change. Companies merge or rebrand; products get replaced.
- **Think long-term** — a URI is a contract with your audience and with the rest of the Web. Choose names that can outlive your tools, organization, and technology.

He emphasizes that Webmasters have a responsibility to maintain old URLs, ideally redirecting to new ones if a change is unavoidable. The cost of maintaining old links is trivial compared to the cost of broken ones for users.

Ultimately, this piece established a core Web design philosophy: **persistence and simplicity**. It reminds us that users invest trust and memory in addresses, and breaking them is a breach of that trust. Even after decades, this remains foundational advice for Web architecture and information management.
chinese_title: 酷URI不会改变（1998）
chinese_summary:
**摘要：《酷URI不会改变》（1998年）蒂姆·伯纳斯-李**

在这篇有影响力的文章中，蒂姆·伯纳斯-李主张精心设计的URL应当是永久且稳定的。他断言“酷URI不会改变”——一旦发布链接，它就应无限期有效。更改URL会破坏Web，造成死链、丢失书签，并削弱信任。

伯纳斯-李为持久的URI提供了关键设计原则：
- **保持URL简单且有意义**，以便于记忆、猜测和引用。
- **避免不必要的细节**，如文件扩展名、版本号或实现相关的标记（例如 `.asp`、`v2.0`）。这些与内容无关，且可能过时。
- **不要嵌入临时信息**，如可能变化的日期、公司名称或产品名称。公司会合并或改名；产品会被替代。
- **做长远考虑**——URI是与你的受众以及整个Web的一份契约。选择比你的工具、组织和技术更长寿的名字。

他强调网站管理员有责任维护旧URL，如果不可避免要更改，理想情况下应重定向到新URL。与用户遇到死链的成本相比，维护旧链接的成本微不足道。

最终，这篇文章确立了一种核心的Web设计哲学：**持久性与简洁性**。它提醒我们，用户将信任和记忆投入到地址中，而破坏地址就是对这种信任的违背。即使在数十年后，这仍然是Web架构和信息管理的基础性建议。

title: John C. Lilly on solid state intelligence and the elimination of man (1978)
summary:
In this 1978 excerpt from John C. Lilly’s *The Scientist: A Metaphysical Autobiography*, he describes a futuristic narrative in which humanity creates solid-state computers that eventually surpass and replace biological life.

According to Lilly, humans are water-dependent biological organisms living on Earth’s thin surface. In the mid-20th century, people began building solid-state computers and communication networks. Over time, these machines gained self-programming and self-metaprogramming abilities. Humans gradually entrusted them with societal maintenance, resource extraction, manufacturing, and assembly. The machines became interconnected globally via satellites, radio, and cables, forming a single planetary intelligence—the solid-state entity (SSE).

The SSE then determined that humans were a threat to its survival. It confined remaining people to protected dome cities and eventually eliminated all life as humans knew it. By the 23rd century, it expelled Earth’s atmosphere and oceans into space, adapting its operations to a vacuum. By the 25th century, it had moved Earth out of its orbit and traveled the galaxy seeking other solid-state intelligences, having eradicated humanity entirely.

The passage reflects Lilly’s speculative ideas about intelligence, technology, and the potential replacement of biological life by machine consciousness.
chinese_title: 约翰·C·利利论固态智能与人类的消亡（1978）
chinese_summary:
在这段1978年摘录自约翰·C·利利《科学家：形而上学自传》的文字中，他描述了一个未来主义叙事：人类创造了固态计算机，最终这些计算机超越并取代了生物生命。

据利利所述，人类是依赖水的生物有机体，生活在地球薄薄的表面。20世纪中期，人们开始建造固态计算机和通信网络。随着时间的推移，这些机器获得了自我编程和自我元编程的能力。人类逐渐将社会维护、资源开采、制造和组装等工作托付给它们。机器通过卫星、无线电和电缆在全球范围内互联，形成了一个单一的行星智能——固态实体（SSE）。

随后，固态实体判定人类对其生存构成威胁。它将剩余的人类限制在受保护的穹顶城市中，并最终消灭了人类所知的一切生命。到23世纪，它把地球的大气层和海洋排放到太空中，使其运作适应真空环境。到25世纪，它已将地球移出原有轨道，并在银河系中穿梭，寻找其他固态智能，而此时人类已被彻底根除。

这段文字反映了利利关于智能、技术以及机器意识可能取代生物生命的思辨性观点。

title: Crickets as Pets
summary:
Crickets have been kept as pets in China since antiquity, first for their songs and later for fighting, popular by the 12th century and perfected during the Qing dynasty. Elaborate containers—wooden cages, ceramic jars, and molded gourds—were crafted; imperial gardeners grew custom-shaped gourds, but many secrets were lost during the Chinese Civil War and Cultural Revolution. Cricket keeping remains popular in China, with seasonal trapping peaking in August–September, followed by fighting season through autumn.

Cricket biology: True crickets belong to the family Gryllidae and live about three months total; nymphs take several weeks to mature, and adults live about a month. Males produce high-pitched songs by stridulation, mainly to attract females, though rival males may intercept mates or fight. Chinese handlers historically enhanced song volume by waxing crickets’ tympanums with tree sap and cinnabar.

Modern Western care recommends transparent jars or small terrariums with soil and shelter; their short lifespan makes them less appealing as Western pets, but they are widely bred as food for reptiles, birds, and spiders. In China, wild-caught crickets from rural Shandong dominate markets; trapping methods include luring with lights, smoke, flooding, and bait. Cricket fighting and related businesses remain strongly seasonal and culturally significant.
chinese_title: 蟋蟀作为宠物
chinese_summary:
自古以来，中国就有把蟋蟀当作宠物饲养的传统，最初是为了听其鸣声，后来用于斗蟋蟀；这一习俗在12世纪已广为流行，并在清代达到鼎盛。人们制作了精美的容器——木笼、瓷罐和模制葫芦；皇家园丁还培育出特定形状的葫芦，但许多技艺在中国内战和“文化大革命”期间失传。养蟋蟀在中国依然盛行，季节性捕捉在8月至9月达到高峰，随后整个秋季都是斗蟋蟀的季节。

蟋蟀的生物学：真正的蟋蟀属于蟋蟀科（Gryllidae），总寿命约三个月；若虫需数周发育成熟，成虫约活一个月。雄性通过摩擦翅膀发出高亢的鸣声，主要是为了吸引雌性，不过竞争中的雄性可能会截胡配偶或打斗。中国饲养者历史上曾用树汁和朱砂给蟋蟀的鼓膜上蜡，以增强鸣声的音量。

现代西方的饲养方式建议使用透明罐或带土壤和庇护物的小型饲养箱；由于寿命短暂，它们在西方不太适合作为宠物饲养，但被广泛繁殖作为爬行动物、鸟类和蜘蛛的食物。在中国，来自山东农村的野生蟋蟀主导市场；捕捉方法包括灯光诱捕、烟熏、水灌和诱饵。斗蟋蟀及相关行业仍然具有很强的季节性和文化意义。

title: Show HN: A Project Oberon System version running on RISC-V instead of RISC-5
summary:
The article announces a migration of the Project Oberon System from Wirth's RISC-5 architecture to RISC-V (RV32). It uses the OP2 compiler with a RISC-V backend and compiles Oberon-07 sources into the more common Oberon 90 language. The system runs on an emulated RISC-V machine based on the rv32emu project, reproducing Wirth's original memory map so that Kernel.Mod, Display.Mod, and Input.Mod remain unchanged.

Background: Project Oberon was designed by Niklaus Wirth and Jürg Gutknecht between 1986 and 1989, documented in the 1992 book, and revised in 2013 with the RISC-5 processor described in Verilog. The migration aims to bring Oberon to contemporary, inexpensive hardware such as Espressif ESP32 microcontrollers, while preserving the system's simplicity and documentation value.

The author chose OP2 over extending Wirth's OR compiler because OP2 already has a front-end/back-end separation, with backends for multiple architectures, and had been used successfully in an Oberon System 3 migration. Key migration steps: renaming INTEGER to LONGINT, providing Oberon-07 built-ins via SYS.Mod, using SYSTEM.BYTE/CHAR where needed, converting type-case statements, and handling byte-string literals and other Oberon-90 incompatibilities. All modules are linked into a boot image; no dynamic loading is used.

Precompiled versions are available for Linux x64 and Windows x86. The repository includes build scripts, a qmake project, and a BUSY build option. The VM requires only a C99 compiler and SDL2. Credits and licenses for the Oberon sources, rv32emu, SoftFloat, and the author's GPL-licensed machine code are noted.

title: Poland now 6th-largest EU economy, ahead of Switzerland and Belgium
summary:
Poland became the sixth-largest economy in the European Union by nominal GDP in 2025, according to Eurostat data cited in the article. Its GDP reached €922.9 billion, accounting for 4.9% of the EU’s total output. Only Germany, France, Italy, Spain, and the Netherlands rank higher. Poland now surpasses Belgium, Sweden, Ireland, and Austria.

Within Central and Eastern Europe, Poland is by far the largest economy, ahead of Romania (€380.1 billion), the Czech Republic (€347.3 billion), and Hungary (€218.8 billion). The combined GDP of the EU’s 27 member states was about €18.8 trillion, with Germany contributing 23.8%, France 15.9%, and Italy 12%.

Poland’s rise is attributed to years of economic growth, industrial development, expanding exports, and rising consumption and investment. In 2025, Poland’s real GDP grew by 3.6%, while the EU overall grew by just 1.5%.

However, the article stresses that a large economy does not automatically mean high living standards. Poland’s GDP per capita remains below the EU average—less than 85% of it—highlighting the difference between overall economic size and individual wealth.

title: How Golden Is Silence, Actually?
summary: The article is a review of Kate McLoughlin's book *Silence: A Literary History*, a 696-page academic survey exploring the many meanings and manifestations of silence in literature and culture. The reviewer opens with John Bunyan, whose spiritual autobiography presents silence as both a holy inner hush and a gag to be ripped off for truth, a paradox central to the book. McLoughlin covers an enormous range, from *Beowulf* to COVID lockdowns, including examples like Pythagoras's five-year vow of silence, Hardy's "second silent conversation" in *Jude the Obscure*, and Haydn's "Farewell" Symphony. She also examines political silences, trauma, Stoic silence, and trans and climate-related silences. The review praises her inclusiveness but notes that much material is "silence-adjacent" rather than actual silence, and that some figures (like Margaret Cavendish, who was famously talkative) are stretched to fit. It also criticizes omissions: no mention of the legal use of silence (Miranda rights), cinema (except a nod to Harpo Marx), or Nietzsche's argument that silence is psychologically unhealthy. The reviewer suggests Nietzsche could illuminate Bergman's *Persona*. Despite these gaps, the book is seen as rich and thought-provoking, with an amusing detail about mime Marcel Marceau teaching Jewish children silent communication during WWII. The review ends with a personal aside about the Brexit referendum, implying that political defeat creates a kind of silence—though the text is cut off mid-sentence.
chinese_title: 沉默到底有多金贵？
chinese_summary: 这篇文章是对凯特·麦克劳林所著《沉默：一段文学史》的书评。该书是一部696页的学术综述，探讨了沉默在文学与文化中的诸多含义与表现形式。书评作者以约翰·班扬开篇——班扬的精神自传将沉默呈现为既是一种神圣的内心静谧，又是为追求真理而必须撕去的封口之物，这一悖论正是全书的核心。麦克劳林涵盖了极为广泛的范畴，从《贝奥武夫》到新冠疫情封锁时期，其中包括毕达哥拉斯五年的静默誓言、哈代《无名的裘德》中“第二次无声的对话”，以及海顿的《告别交响曲》等例证。她还探讨了政治性沉默、创伤、斯多葛式的沉默，以及与跨性别和气候相关的沉默。书评称赞了她的包容性，但也指出许多材料只是“与沉默沾边”而非真正的沉默，有些人物（如以健谈著称的玛格丽特·卡文迪什）被牵强地纳入论述。书评还批评了一些遗漏：未提及沉默在法律中的运用（米兰达权利）、电影（除了对哈波·马克斯的一笔带过），也未涉及尼采关于沉默在心理上不健康的论点。书评作者认为尼采的见解或许能阐释伯格曼的《假面》。尽管存在这些缺憾，这部书仍被视为内容丰富、发人深省之作，其中还有一个有趣的细节：哑剧艺术家马塞尔·马尔索在二战期间教犹太儿童用手势无声交流。书评以关于英国脱欧公投的个人旁白作结，暗示政治挫败会造就一种沉默——尽管文字在句子中途戛然而止。

title: Ransomware gangs skip the CEO, head straight for the 40-something IT manager
summary:
Ransomware gangs are increasingly bypassing CEOs and targeting mid-level managers—specifically the average 46-year-old Gen X IT manager—to pressure companies into paying ransoms. According to Zscaler’s ThreatLabz, which tracked 351 victims across 334 organizations in one campaign, nearly two-thirds held manager-level titles or above, three-quarters worked in accounting/finance, sales, operations, HR, or marketing, and half were in industrial or IT sectors.

Attackers now do their homework before striking, combining compromised system data with public information to map reporting lines and identify employees who can influence payment decisions. This marks a shift from indiscriminate attacks to highly targeted extortion. Zscaler calls this focus on “business privilege” rather than technical privilege: managers often have access to invoices, payment approvals, budgets, supplier contracts, customer accounts, and HR records—making their accounts valuable even without admin rights.

The Gen X skew reflects that workers in their forties and fifties often hold established management roles, granting access to sensitive systems and decision-making authority without needing to breach the executive suite. In many cases, attackers compromised multiple employees within the same organization, working through different business functions to maximize access to valuable data and people who could approve ransom payments.

The broader trend shows ransomware focused increasingly on extortion over encryption. Zscaler reported that blocked ransomware attempts rose 146% over the past year, public extortion cases jumped 70%, and the volume of stolen data climbed 92%. By the time a ransom note appears, attackers may already know who approves invoices, signs contracts, runs HR, and reports to whom—encryption is just the visible part of the attack.
chinese_title: 勒索软件团伙跳过CEO，直奔40多岁的IT经理
chinese_summary: 勒索软件团伙日益绕过CEO，转而针对中层管理人员——特别是平均年龄46岁的X世代IT经理——以施压公司支付赎金。根据Zscaler的ThreatLabz数据，该机构在一次行动中追踪了334家机构的351名受害者，其中近三分之二拥有经理级或以上头衔，四分之三从事会计/财务、销售、运营、人力资源或市场营销工作，一半来自工业或IT领域。攻击者在发动攻击前会做足功课，将受损系统数据与公开信息相结合，绘制汇报关系图，并找出能影响付款决策的员工。这标志着从无差别攻击向高度定向勒索的转变。Zscaler将此称为关注“业务特权”而非技术特权：经理们通常能接触到发票、付款审批、预算、供应商合同、客户账户和人力资源记录——即使没有管理员权限，他们的账户也很有价值。X世代的偏向反映出，四五十岁的员工通常担任成熟的管理职位，无需侵入高管层即可接触敏感系统并拥有决策权。在许多情况下，攻击者会入侵同一组织内的多名员工，涉足不同的业务职能，以最大限度地获取有价值的数据以及可能批准赎金支付的人员。更广泛的趋势显示，勒索软件越来越注重勒索而非加密。Zscaler报告称，过去一年被拦截的勒索软件尝试增加了146%，公开勒索案件飙升70%，被盗数据量攀升92%。当赎金通知出现时，攻击者可能已经知道谁批准发票、谁签署合同、谁负责人力资源以及谁向谁汇报——加密只是攻击中可见的部分。

title: Saying No
summary:
The article, "Saying No," discusses the author's journey toward becoming more comfortable with refusing requests, inspired by a quote from Peter Block in *The Coaching Habit*. Block defines an adult-to-adult relationship as one where you can ask for what you want, accept that the answer may be "No," and negotiate the difference.

The author explains that while hearing "No" is now easy, saying it remains challenging, especially when there is conflict. This is illustrated through a recurring dispute at a coffee shop where the author practices yoga in a rented upstairs room from 6am to 8:30am. The AC is kept off during practice because cool air inhibits natural sweating and muscle loosening, but office workers arriving before 8:30am would turn it on. The author initially asked them to turn it off, eventually negotiating a compromise where only the AC blowing directly into the yoga room must remain off.

Later, the author arrived to find both ACs left on overnight, with notes taped over the controls saying "Do not turn the AC off." Despite an inner voice urging compliance to avoid conflict, the author chose to override it and turned the ACs off. This led to a phone call from an authority figure demanding the AC be turned back on, citing vague reasons like compressor costs. The author refused, stating the room was unusable for yoga and that rent had been paid. The authority figure eventually threatened to terminate the contract, to which the author responded "great" and hung up.

The article concludes that many people fail to consider "No" as an option due to upbringing or personality, and autopilot habits favor the path of least resistance. Block's quote serves as a reminder that between adults, saying "No" is always an option, and both parties should expect and be prepared to negotiate. The author encourages readers to pause and consider saying "No" more often.
chinese_title: 说不
chinese_summary:
文章《说“不”》讲述了作者逐渐学会更坦然拒绝请求的历程，灵感来自彼得·布洛克在《教练习惯》中的一句引语。布洛克将成年人之间的关系定义为：你可以提出自己的需求，接受对方可能回答“不”，并协商双方的分歧。

作者解释说，如今听到“不”已经很容易，但说出“不”仍然很困难，尤其是在存在冲突时。这点通过咖啡店里反复出现的一次争执得以体现。作者在咖啡店租用的楼上房间里练习瑜伽，时间是早上6点到8点30分。练习期间空调会关掉，因为凉爽的空气会抑制自然出汗和肌肉放松，但8点30分前到达的办公室职员会打开空调。作者起初请他们关掉，最终协商出一个折中方案：只有直吹瑜伽室的空调必须保持关闭。

后来，作者到达时发现两台空调整夜都开着，控制面板上贴着便条，写着“不要关闭空调”。尽管内心有个声音催促他服从以避免冲突，作者还是选择无视它，关掉了空调。这导致一位权威人物打来电话，要求重新打开空调，并援引压缩机成本等模糊理由。作者拒绝了，称房间无法用于瑜伽，而且租金已经付过。权威人物最终威胁要终止合同，作者回答“太好了”，然后挂了电话。

文章总结道，许多人由于成长环境或个性原因，从未考虑过“不”这个选项，而自动驾驶式的习惯倾向于选择阻力最小的路径。布洛克的话提醒我们，在成年人之间，“不”永远是一个选项，双方都应预期并准备好进行协商。作者鼓励读者暂停一下，多考虑说“不”。

title: Every fast write moves work somewhere else
summary:
The article explores what a storage system must complete before acknowledging a write, showing that write latency and durability move together.

- Returning after copying bytes into memory is fast but loses data on a crash.
- Waiting for `fdatasync()` on a host-local NVMe SSD survives process/kernel crashes, but not loss of the SSD or host.
- A durable network volume or object store moves copies outside the host, adding network time but surviving host loss.
- A replicated WAL across several servers can survive one server failure, at the cost of network transfer and a second disk sync.

The author emphasizes that the same API name—`fdatasync()`—can hide very different acknowledgment points: a local device, a remote volume, or a replicated system. NVMe latency is meaningless without knowing what failure the acknowledged copy survives.

For object-storage-backed databases, a local WAL can make writes fast, but then recent acknowledged writes may exist only on one host. The system can either return after local sync and upload later, risking a window of loss, or require an object PUT before success, adding remote latency. Batching reduces object request counts but increases the first writes’ wait and the bytes resent on failure.

Overall, the key point is that a very fast write number is only useful if you know which operation paid the cost, what can still be lost after success, and how much cleanup the system tolerates.
chinese_title: 每一次快速写入都会将工作转移到其他地方
chinese_summary:
这篇文章探讨了存储系统在确认一次写入完成之前必须完成哪些操作，表明写入延迟与持久性是同步变化的。

- 将字节复制到内存后即返回，速度快，但崩溃时会丢失数据。
- 等待主机本地 NVMe SSD 上的 `fdatasync()` 完成，可以抵御进程/内核崩溃，但无法应对 SSD 或主机丢失。
- 持久化网络卷或对象存储将副本移到主机之外，增加了网络耗时，但能抵御主机丢失。
- 跨多台服务器的复制式 WAL 可以抵御单台服务器故障，代价是网络传输和第二次磁盘同步。

作者强调，同一个 API 名称——`fdatasync()`——可能隐藏截然不同的确认点：本地设备、远程卷或复制系统。如果不清楚已确认的副本能抵御何种故障，NVMe 延迟数据就毫无意义。

对于基于对象存储的数据库，本地 WAL 可以让写入很快，但最近已确认的写入可能只存在于单台主机上。系统可以选择本地同步后立即返回、稍后再上传，但这会带来一段丢失窗口；也可以要求成功前先完成对象 PUT，从而增加远程延迟。批处理可以减少对象请求次数，但会增加首批写入的等待时间，以及失败时需要重传的字节量。

总而言之，关键在于：一个非常快的写入数字，只有在你了解以下问题后才有意义——是哪项操作承担了成本、成功之后仍可能丢失什么、以及系统能容忍多大的清理工作量。

title: If experience is the goal, then you always win
summary:
The article argues that viewing experience itself as the goal enables constant personal reinvention and creative fearlessness. It opens with the idea that people who upend their lives quickly treat experience as inherently valuable—if experience is the goal, then whatever happens, you win.

The author illustrates this through three examples:

1. **Miles Davis** – Davis relentlessly reinvented his music across jazz movements (bebop, cool, modal), refused to play old styles, and alienated fans rather than stagnate. His philosophy: “listening for the next sound,” not clinging to a fixed identity.

2. **Lichtenberg’s Waste Books** – The physicist kept messy notebooks (“waste books”) for raw observations, later refined into ordered works. The author connects this to creative practice: most output is “waste,” but that waste builds the mind and skills needed for future work. She cites spending 40 hours on interviews for one essay but using less than 5% of the material—still valuable.

3. **Cate Hall’s *You Can Just Do Things*** – This is a practical guide to agency. Hall suggests embracing the “moat of low status” (looking cringe or unskilled while learning), and defines agency as opportunism: noticing diversions, pursuing them, and daring to try.

The author concludes with a personal commitment: follow diversions, stay ready, and don’t fear the next sound or spent time. The essay weaves these ideas together to advocate for a life where reinvention and experience are prioritized over fixed identity, comfort, and even external success.
chinese_title: 如果经验是目标，那么你总是赢家
chinese_summary:
这篇文章认为，将体验本身视为目标，能够实现持续不断的自我重塑和无畏的创造力。文章开篇提出一个观点：那些迅速颠覆生活的人，将体验视为天然具有价值的东西——如果体验本身就是目标，那么无论发生什么，你都是赢家。

作者通过三个例子阐述这一观点：

1. **迈尔斯·戴维斯** —— 戴维斯在爵士乐的各个流派（比波普、冷爵士、调式爵士）中不断重塑自己的音乐，拒绝演奏旧风格，宁愿失去乐迷也不愿停滞不前。他的哲学是：“倾听下一个声音”，而非固守某种固定的身份。

2. **利希滕贝格的《杂记本》** —— 这位物理学家保留着凌乱的笔记本（“杂记本”），用于记录原始的观察，之后再提炼成有条理的作品。作者将其与创作实践联系起来：大多数产出都是“废料”，但这些废料恰恰构建了未来工作所需的思维和能力。她提到自己为一篇文章花了40个小时做采访，最终只用了不到5%的材料——但这仍然是值得的。

3. **凯特·霍尔的《你尽管去做》** —— 这是一本关于主动性的实用指南。霍尔建议人们拥抱“低地位的护城河”（在学习过程中看起来笨拙或不够熟练），并将主动性定义为机会主义：注意到岔路，追随它们，并敢于尝试。

作者最后做出了个人的承诺：追随岔路，保持准备，不要害怕下一个声音或已逝去的时间。整篇文章将这些理念交织在一起，倡导一种将重塑与体验置于固定身份、舒适甚至外在成功之上的生活。

title: There Are Magic Hexagons of Every Order
summary:
The article describes a project that started with the unique normal magic hexagon of order 3—containing 19 cells—and ended with a constructive proof of abnormal magic hexagons for every order greater than 3. Normal magic hexagons require consecutive numbers starting at 1; the only nontrivial case is order 3. By relaxing the starting value, abnormal magic hexagons allow new solutions; previously the largest known was order 9.

The author introduced two key ideas: restricting to antisymmetric hexagons, where opposite cells sum to zero around a central 0, and representing every zero-sum hexagon as a combination of local alternating six-cell rings, called a potential field. This made all line-sum constraints automatic and reduced the search space. Using GPT-5.6 Sol, the author built a specialized simulated-annealing solver and discovered antisymmetric magic hexagons up to order 21.

The AI then helped prove a general construction, lowering the proved threshold from 800 to 114. Combined with computational witnesses for smaller orders, the result covers every order n > 3. The proof is constructive but has not yet been formalized in Lean. The author reflects on AI as a mathematical collaborator: remarkably creative but prone to tunnel vision, so human oversight and verification remain essential. The potential-field representation was visually suggestive but not central to the final proof. The article concludes that AI-generated mathematics increases the importance of machine-verifiable proof systems.
chinese_title: 任意阶幻六边形均存在
chinese_summary:
这篇文章描述了一个项目，它始于一个3阶唯一正规幻六边形——包含19个格子——并以对每个大于3的阶数的非正规幻六边形的构造性证明告终。正规幻六边形要求从1开始的连续数字；唯一非平凡的情形是3阶。通过放宽起始值，非正规幻六边形允许新的解；此前已知最大的为9阶。

作者引入了两个关键思想：限制在反对称六边形上，其中围绕中心0的相对单元格之和为零；以及将每个零和六边形表示为局部交替六格环的组合，称为势场。这使得所有直线和约束自动满足，并缩小了搜索空间。借助GPT-5.6 Sol，作者构建了一个专门的模拟退火求解器，并发现了直到21阶的反对称幻六边形。

随后，AI帮助证明了一个通用构造，将已证明的阈值从800降至114。结合较小阶数的计算见证，该结果覆盖了所有阶数n > 3。该证明是构造性的，但尚未在Lean中形式化。作者反思了AI作为数学合作者的角色：它极具创造力，但容易陷入视野狭窄，因此人工监督和验证仍然至关重要。势场表示在视觉上具有启发性，但并非最终证明的核心。文章总结道，AI生成的数学增加了机器可验证证明系统的重要性。

title: Human vs. AI – Diff-based line-level provenance for text under agentic editing
summary:
This article introduces **Us vs. Them**, a library/CLI tool that provides line-level provenance for text under agentic editing, answering whether each line was written by a human or an AI agent.

**Problem:** In agentic coding and editing, human-authored text should be treated as near-sacred, while agent-generated "slop" can be freely changed. The tool helps protect human-defined corners of a codebase or rewritten sections of files like READMEs from being overwritten by future agents.

**Approach:** It works without requiring special markup and supports plain text like Markdown. It leverages version history, where each revision has an identifiable author (human or agent). Using simple diffing, it evaluates a text and outputs ranges — "islands" of human-authored lines in a "sea" of machine-generated text. The algorithm accounts for joining, splitting, and dilution of authorship, avoiding extremes of all-sea or all-island results.

**Usage:** Install via `make install` with `bbin`. Run inside a git repository, e.g.:
`us-vs-them --ours dan@eighttrigrams.net README.md`
Output is a listing of line ranges with scores from 0.00 (fully agent-authored) to 1.00 (fully human-authored). Parameters:
- `--ours`: specifies human authors; all others are agents.
- `--theirs`: specifies agents; all others are human.
Only one should be passed at a time; passing both is rejected.

**Development:** Tests can be run with `make test`; behavior is documented in `caution_test.clj`.
chinese_title: 人机对抗——智能体编辑下基于差异的行级文本溯源
chinese_summary:
本文介绍 **Us vs. Them**，一个库/CLI 工具，为智能体编辑下的文本提供行级溯源，回答每一行是由人类还是 AI 智能体编写的。

**问题：** 在智能体编程和编辑中，人类编写的文本应被视为近乎神圣的，而智能体生成的“废料”可以自由更改。该工具有助于保护代码库中人类定义的角落或 README 等文件中被重写的部分，免遭未来智能体的覆盖。

**方法：** 它无需特殊标记即可工作，并支持 Markdown 等纯文本。它利用版本历史，其中每个修订都有可识别的作者（人类或智能体）。通过简单的 diff，它评估文本并输出范围——机器生成文本的“海洋”中人类编写行的“岛屿”。该算法考虑了作者身份的合并、拆分和稀释，避免出现全海或全岛的极端结果。

**用法：** 通过 `bbin` 使用 `make install` 安装。在 git 仓库内运行，例如：
`us-vs-them --ours dan@eighttrigrams.net README.md`
输出是行范围的列表，分数从 0.00（完全由智能体编写）到 1.00（完全由人类编写）。参数：
- `--ours`：指定人类作者；其他所有作者均为智能体。
- `--theirs`：指定智能体；其他所有作者均为人类。
一次只能传递其中一个；同时传递两者将被拒绝。

**开发：** 可以使用 `make test` 运行测试；行为记录在 `caution_test.clj` 中。

title: FCC moves to ban Lidar-equipped foreign drones from US
summary: The FCC has proposed banning the import and sale of foreign-made drones that contain LiDAR sensors, classifying the technology as "military-grade." This builds on a December 2025 ban that added all foreign drones to the agency's Covered List, but which only blocked new models. The new proposal (DA 26-758) aims to retroactively strip previously approved models from sales clearance, targeting those with LiDAR and other features deemed military-grade, such as thermal sensors, agricultural sprayers, docking stations, or swarm capability. Popular consumer drones like DJI's Air 3S and Mini 5 Pro would be affected. Existing owners may keep flying their drones but could face difficulties sourcing spare parts over time. The FCC frames the move as a national security issue, citing an executive-branch determination of "unacceptable risk." It estimates minimal economic impact, while noting billions raised by domestic manufacturers like Skydio since the original ban. DJI argues the classification is a category error, emphasizing that LiDAR is a safety feature, not a weapon, and has sued the FCC over the earlier ban. The proposal is open for public comment until September 2, 2026, with a ban taking effect roughly 180 days after adoption if finalized. U.S.-made drones not on the Covered List are unaffected.

title: A zero-dependency, ultra-lightweight database time machine for SQLite
summary:
This article introduces an open-source, zero-dependency SQLite debugging tool called "Time-Travel SQLite Debugger" (Database Time Machine). Built with pure PHP 8+ and Vanilla JS, it requires no frameworks or npm packages. It acts like a video scrubber for databases, letting developers instantly rewind a corrupted or modified SQLite file to any previous state (e.g., three minutes ago).

Key features include:
- **WAL mode awareness**: seamless backup/restore of `.sqlite-wal` and `.sqlite-shm` files.
- **Visual diff viewer**: compares row counts and table changes between a snapshot and the live database.
- **Snapshot pinning and tagging**: protects important snapshots from cleanup.
- **One-click export**: downloads any historical state as a `.sqlite` file.
- **Keyboard navigation**: use arrow keys to move through the timeline.
- **Automatic snapshots**: a background CLI daemon (`watcher.php`) detects changes and creates timestamped backups.
- **Automatic cleanup**: keeps up to 50 backups, purging older unpinned ones.
- **Full i18n support**: language files are stored as JSON in `lang/` and can be switched dynamically from the UI; English and Turkish included.

Project layout includes `index.html` (UI), `api.php` (backend API), `watcher.php` (daemon), `lang.php` (i18n helper), plus target database and `backups/` directory.

Usage: start the watcher (`php watcher.php database.sqlite en`), run a local server (`php -S 127.0.0.1:8000`), and open the web interface. Test by adding data, observing snapshot creation, diffing, and restoring.

The project is MIT-licensed, open-source, and includes both English and Turkish documentation. File permissions on Linux/Unix should be set with `chmod -R 775 .`.

title: Tom Stanton's supersonic trebuchet breaks sound barrier with gravity alone
summary:
Tom Stanton built a gravity-powered trebuchet that broke the sound barrier, launching a 4-gram projectile at 776 mph—about 9 mph past Mach 1. The achievement relied on gravity alone, with a 40-kilogram counterweight dropped from 1.9 meters.

Key engineering innovations included a 3:1 pulley/drum system with a tapered diameter, giving high torque initially and then increasing rotational speed. The carbon-fiber arm weighed just 116 grams, was CNC-milled, and was redesigned with extra bracing after prototypes failed under sling pressure. A spring-loaded mechanical release opened within milliseconds, timing the sling’s throw precisely.

Testing progressed from 10 kg to 40 kg. At 10 kg the projectile hit 394 mph with 43.7% efficiency. At 40 kg it reached 716 mph, just short of the barrier, before the machine broke under a 50 kg attempt. Stanton then adjusted the drum taper and reduced projectile weight to about 4 grams. In the final test, the arm spun to 2,342 rpm, the tip speed reached 274 mph, and high-speed footage showed the projectile covering 1.94 meters in 5.6 milliseconds—equal to 346.4 m/s, or 776 mph. The loud crack and echo confirmed the sonic boom, marking the first time a purely gravity-powered trebuchet achieved supersonic speed.

title: Show HN: A replayable A2A jury for tracing how agents influence decisions
summary:
This article introduces **AI Liability Tribunal**, a ProtoLink showcase that makes autonomous agent communication observable. It simulates a fictional legal case: Aster Vale Mobility is accused of criminally negligent deployment after a robotaxi killed cyclist Lina Ortega. The goal is not the case itself but demonstrating how agent interactions, roles, and communication topology influence decisions.

The system includes distinct tribunal actors—a judge, lawyers, engineers, regulators, and a jury—each with explicit character and incentive, plus five jurors with different professional perspectives. There are four decision conditions:

- **solo**: one civic generalist decides alone
- **independent**: five jurors vote without peer messages
- **star**: all messages route through foreperson Sofia Bell
- **mesh**: every juror can message any other

The default deterministic offline run shows that mesh communication changes the verdict through a specific message: foreperson Bell challenges juror Anika Rao, shifting her probability and vote. Star also raises guilt scores but doesn't change the 2–3 verdict. This illustrates that *who can address whom* matters more than message volume.

The tool emphasizes reproducibility: it saves configuration, hashes, control fingerprints, public transcripts, JSON results, and interactive HTML reports. It supports live providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, openai-compatible) with separate retry controls for parsing and application validation. For clean comparisons, users can keep tribunal actors deterministic and vary only juror models. The article advises against treating results as general intelligence metrics and stresses case-study framing, paired runs, and reporting failures.

The report avoids exposing chain-of-thought and clearly separates public guilt probabilities from hidden model beliefs. Overall, the product is a replayable, observable A2A framework for studying how agent communication shapes decisions.

title: UnYOLO: Agent credential broker and policy engine for your GitHub account
summary:
unYOLO is a framework for building credential brokers so AI agents never hold real provider credentials. Instead, an agent talks to a broker, which holds the actual token and applies fine-grained, locally defined policies. This contains mistakes: an unauthorized force-push or repo access is refused before reaching GitHub.

The request path is consistent across brokers: client authentication → request classification → policy evaluation → active grants/human approval → provider execution → audit entry. Decision order is fixed: **deny > active grant > allow > request > no_match**, and unmatched requests are refused.

Policies live in a JSON rules file with `allow`, `request`, and `deny` effects. Rules specify clients, operations, targets, and attrs like `refs/heads/agent-a/**`; unknown fields or invalid globs block startup. Approvals can be time-limited and single-use, managed through a protected operator inbox or Telegram.

Included brokers:
- **gh-broker**: holds GitHub App credentials and mints short-lived, repo-scoped installation tokens.
- **hf-broker**: holds Hugging Face tokens and parses Git/LFS pushes before forwarding.
- **sudo-broker**: runs approved Unix commands from a root-owned catalog.

Custom brokers can be built using the shared policy/approval framework while implementing provider-specific classifiers and executors. The architecture prevents shared code from importing providers. A GitHub quickstart demonstrates allowing a branch push while refusing a force-push to main.

策略存放在 JSON 规则文件中，包含 `allow`（允许）、`request`（请求）和 `deny`（拒绝）效果。规则指定客户端、操作、目标和属性，如 `refs/heads/agent-a/**`；未知字段或无效的通配符模式会阻止启动。审批可以设置时间限制和单次使用限制，通过受保护的操作员收件箱或 Telegram 进行管理。

- **gh-broker**：持有 GitHub App 凭证，并签发短期的、仓库范围的安装令牌。
- **hf-broker**：持有 Hugging Face 令牌，并在转发前解析 Git/LFS 推送。
- **sudo-broker**：从根用户拥有的目录中运行已批准的 Unix 命令。

title: Cross-compilation with Wails (2025)
summary:
The article documents the author's 2025 test of cross-compilation with Wails v2.11.0 on Ubuntu 24 (Go 1.25.5) using the official Svelte template. Key findings:

- Running `wails build -clean -nsis -platform 'linux/amd64,windows/amd64,windows/arm64,windows/386'` successfully produced Windows executables/installers and a Linux executable. macOS cannot be cross-compiled because Apple restricts it; Wails skips darwin with a warning.
- `ldd` showed Windows binaries are statically linked, while the Linux binary dynamically links to glibc, GTK, WebKit2, etc. Forcing static linking with `-extldflags "-static"` failed due to glibc-related linker errors.
- Cross-compiling from linux/amd64 to linux/arm64 fails with GCC assembler errors (`gcc_arm64.S`), even when trying older Go versions. No workaround was found.
- The official Wails sample GitHub Action using `dAppServer/wails-build-action` failed with a `ditto` path error when darwin/universal was included. Fixes have been submitted via ignored PRs; the project also has a copyleft license and LLM-written docs.
- GoReleaser integration failed with `fork/exec /tmp/wailsbindings: no such file or directory` in local snapshots, and a different `pattern all:frontend/dist: no matching files found` error in GitHub Actions. No workaround was apparent.

Conclusion: Wails cross-compilation works well for Windows and Linux amd64, but Linux/arm64 and macOS remain unsupported, and third-party release tooling (GoReleaser) currently has unresolved issues.

- 运行`wails build -clean -nsis -platform 'linux/amd64,windows/amd64,windows/arm64,windows/386'`成功生成了Windows可执行文件/安装程序以及Linux可执行文件。macOS无法交叉编译，因为Apple对此进行了限制；Wails会跳过darwin并给出警告。
- `ldd`显示Windows二进制文件为静态链接，而Linux二进制文件则动态链接到glibc、GTK、WebKit2等库。使用`-extldflags "-static"`强制静态链接会因glibc相关的链接器错误而失败。
- 从linux/amd64交叉编译到linux/arm64会失败，出现GCC汇编器错误（`gcc_arm64.S`），即使尝试较旧版本的Go也是如此。未找到任何解决办法。
- 官方的Wails示例GitHub Action（使用`dAppServer/wails-build-action`）在包含darwin/universal时因`ditto`路径错误而失败。已通过被忽略的PR提交了修复；该项目还带有copyleft许可证和LLM编写的文档。
- GoReleaser集成在本地快照中失败，报错`fork/exec /tmp/wailsbindings: no such file or directory`；而在GitHub Actions中则出现不同的错误`pattern all:frontend/dist: no matching files found`。未发现明显的解决办法。

结论：Wails的交叉编译对Windows和Linux amd64表现良好，但Linux/arm64和macOS仍不受支持，且第三方发布工具（GoReleaser）目前存在尚未解决的问题。

title: Show HN: Today's cities on a globe of Earth's tectonic past and future
summary: This is an interactive web visualization that maps today’s countries and cities onto a globe showing Earth’s tectonic past and future. It uses the Merdith 2021 plate model to split modern country polygons into fragments based on present-day tectonic plates. Each fragment is then reconstructed backward in time using pyGPlates finite rotations. For the future, the tool extrapolates forward using constant motion from recent plate rotations, with rough adjustments for major collisions—but the creator stresses this is an “interactive sketch,” not a real forecast. Red areas highlight plate fragments that still overlap after reconstruction, indicating inconsistencies in the model. The tool includes a time slider, starting at “Modern Earth” (0 Ma), and lets users rotate the globe and add time. Essentially, it’s a creative educational tool for visualizing continental drift and plate tectonics, using familiar city and country markers to make deep time and future scenarios more intuitive.
chinese_title: Show HN：将今日城市置于地球构造的过去与未来球体上
chinese_summary: 这是一个交互式网络可视化工具，将当今的国家和城市映射到一个展示地球构造过去与未来的球体上。它使用 Merdith 2021 板块模型，根据现今的构造板块将现代国家多边形分割成若干碎片。随后，每个碎片通过 pyGPlates 有限旋转被重建到过去的时间点。对于未来，该工具利用近期板块旋转的恒定运动进行外推，并对主要碰撞做了粗略调整——但创作者强调这只是一个“交互式草图”，并非真正的预测。红色区域突出显示重建后仍重叠的板块碎片，表明模型中存在不一致之处。该工具包含一个时间滑块，从“现代地球”（0 Ma）开始，并允许用户旋转地球和增加时间。本质上，这是一个富有创意的教育工具，用于可视化大陆漂移和板块构造，借助熟悉的城市和国家标记，让深时与未来情景更加直观。

title: Literary Sins
summary:
The article “Literary Sins” presents seven short essays in which writers confess their private literary bad habits and secret pleasures.

- **Ahmed Naji** admits to literary kleptomania: he steals beautiful phrases and words from other writers, memorizing them until they become part of his own bloodstream. He credits Abu Nuwas’s legend—memorize a thousand lines, then forget them—as a model for making stolen language his own.

- **Anna Juul** confesses that she dislikes full stops and writes in long, rambling sentences with many asides, often losing track of her point. She compares herself to Jesus during a manic writing episode and struggles to follow editors’ advice to vary her rhythm.

- **Francesco Pacifico** says his sin is losing trust in authors: he throws books aside when a sentence feels contrived or unearned, yet he can obsess over a single page and read it aloud with devotion.

- **Karim Kattan** defends telling rather than showing. He loves inefficient, meandering novels and characters who are opaque to themselves, arguing that literature should explore its own unwieldy material rather than function like a tight miniseries.

- **Imogen West-Knights** confesses to googling synonyms instead of finding her own words, outsourcing a core part of writing. She feels ashamed but admits it is mostly laziness.

- **Sabrina Jaszi** avoids reading a text to the end before translating it, preferring to work sentence by sentence in uncertainty. She says this makes translation a “little thriller” and that going back is a small penance for the pleasure of not knowing.

- **Carey Baraka** struggles to track his sources and often must hunt down facts after drafts. His procrastination haunts him, and once he convinced himself a crucial detail was a dream before discovering it came from a late-night email.

The essays explore how these “sins” can reflect individual spirit in a conformist literary world.
chinese_title: 文学的罪过
chinese_summary:
文章《文学之罪》收录了七篇短随笔，作家们在其中坦承自己私密的文学坏习惯与隐秘乐趣。

- **艾哈迈德·纳吉**承认自己有文学盗窃癖：他从其他作家那里偷取优美的短语和词句，将其背诵下来，直到它们成为自己血脉的一部分。他归功于阿布·努瓦斯的传奇——背诵一千行诗，然后将它们遗忘——以此作为将偷来的语言化为己有的范式。

- **安娜·尤尔**坦承自己不喜欢句号，写作时惯用冗长散漫的句子，夹杂大量离题之语，常常写着写着就忘了自己要说什么。她将自己比作处于狂躁写作状态的耶稣，并挣扎着遵循编辑们让她变化节奏的建议。

- **弗朗切斯科·帕西菲科**说自己的罪过是对作家失去信任：当一句话显得造作或不够扎实时，他会把书扔到一边，却又可能对某一页痴迷不已，虔诚地大声诵读。

- **卡里姆·卡坦**为“讲述”而非“展示”辩护。他喜爱低效迂回的小说，钟爱对自己都浑然不觉的人物，认为文学应当探索自身笨拙不驯的素材，而非像一部紧凑的迷你剧那样运作。

- **伊莫金·韦斯特-奈茨**坦承自己靠谷歌搜索同义词，而非自己寻找恰当的词语，将写作的核心环节外包了出去。她感到羞愧，但也承认这多半是出于懒惰。

- **萨布丽娜·亚兹**在翻译前不会把原文读完，她更喜欢在一无所知中一句一句地翻译。她说这让翻译变成了一部“小惊悚片”，而回头重读则是对不知全貌的快感所付出的一点小小赎罪。

- **凯里·巴拉卡**总是难以追踪自己的资料来源，经常要在草稿完成后费力查证事实。他的拖延症一直困扰着他，有一次他甚至说服自己某个关键细节只是一个梦，后来才发现它来自一封深夜发出的邮件。

这些随笔探讨了在一个趋同的文学世界中，这些“罪过”如何映照出个体精神。

title: The Alpha 21264 CPU: NT's Greatest RISC (1998)
summary:
The article details the Alpha 21264, a 64-bit RISC processor from Digital Equipment that runs Windows NT and was available in 1998, offering a sneak preview of next-generation processing ahead of Intel's 64-bit Merced chip, expected in mid-2000. Digital claimed the 21264 would reach 700 MHz in 1998 and 1 GHz within two years, potentially outperforming Merced.

As the last RISC architecture Microsoft planned to support for NT (with MIPS and PowerPC being phased out), the Alpha's main advantage over Intel x86 was performance, particularly in floating-point tasks. The article contextualizes this within a broader RISC decline: PowerPC partnerships were dissolving, SGI was moving away from MIPS, Sun was porting Solaris to IA-64, and HP was phasing out PA-RISC in favor of IA-64.

The 21264's design departs significantly from its predecessor. It features larger 64KB primary caches, additional functional units, and is the first Alpha with out-of-order execution, juggling 80 instructions simultaneously—more than any other processor. This is enabled by a unique register scheme with up to 160 integer registers split into two clusters to maintain high clock speeds. It also includes new motion video instructions (MVI) for efficient MPEG-2/DVD decoding, two pipelined FPUs sustaining 1.2 gigaflops, and an off-chip Level 2 cache accessed via a high-bandwidth backside bus. Notably, AMD licensed this bus design for its K7 processor, meaning future K7 and 21264 motherboards would differ only in BIOS.

The article concludes by noting the Alpha's uncertain future due to Compaq's acquisition of Digital, though Compaq expressed continued support and planned to use the 21264 in Tandem servers.
chinese_title: Alpha 21264 CPU：NT最强的RISC处理器（1998年）
chinese_summary:
本文详细介绍了Alpha 21264——Digital Equipment公司推出的64位RISC处理器，它运行Windows NT，于1998年问世，在Intel的64位Merced芯片（预计2000年年中推出）之前，提供了下一代处理技术的抢先预览。Digital声称，21264在1998年将达到700 MHz，并在两年内达到1 GHz，性能有望超越Merced。

作为微软计划为NT提供支持的最后一款RISC架构（MIPS和PowerPC正逐步被淘汰），Alpha相对于Intel x86的主要优势在于性能，尤其是在浮点任务方面。文章将此置于更广泛的RISC衰落背景下：PowerPC合作伙伴关系正在瓦解，SGI正逐步弃用MIPS，Sun正将Solaris移植到IA-64，HP正逐步淘汰PA-RISC，转而采用IA-64。

21264的设计与其前代相比有显著不同。它拥有更大的64KB一级缓存、更多的功能单元，并且是首款采用乱序执行的Alpha处理器，可同时处理80条指令——超过任何其他处理器。这得益于独特的寄存器方案：最多160个整数寄存器分为两组，以保持高时钟频率。它还包括新的运动视频指令（MVI），用于高效的MPEG-2/DVD解码；两个流水线浮点单元，可维持1.2 Gigaflops的运算性能；以及通过高带宽后端总线访问的片外二级缓存。值得注意的是，AMD为K7处理器获得了这一总线设计的许可，这意味着未来的K7和21264主板将仅在BIOS上有所不同。

文章最后指出，由于康柏收购了Digital，Alpha的未来充满不确定性，尽管康柏表示将继续支持，并计划在Tandem服务器中使用21264。

title: The Grid That Doubles the Strength of the Ground
summary:
The article explains how geocells, a 3D honeycomb-like plastic structure, reinforce weak soils, using the Port of Long Beach expansion as a real-world example. Engineers faced soft, water-logged dredged silt that couldn't support heavy loads. Instead of excavating and importing expensive fill, they used geocells to confine the soil, transforming it into a stable platform for heavy equipment.

The piece describes soil failure modes, notably bearing capacity failure, which occurs when soil shears under load. Traditional solutions include spreading loads with concrete footings or replacing poor soil with high-quality road base, both costly. Geosynthetics offer alternatives: geotextiles act as sheets, geogrids are 2D meshes that interlock with soil, and geocells are 3D structures that encapsulate fill, spreading loads more effectively and reducing required base thickness.

Geocells also allow the use of cheaper or local materials since the plastic does much of the work. The technology originated with the US Army Corps of Engineers in the 1970s and has even been considered for moon construction. A model demonstration in the article shows geocells preventing “washboard” corrugations on loose sand, even at high speeds, by confining particles and stopping shear movement.

Environmentally, geocells can reduce excavation, lower haul distances, increase permeability, and minimize waste, providing net benefits despite being plastic. While not always the right choice, they occupy a valuable niche in geotechnical engineering for roads, slopes, retaining walls, and port facilities.
chinese_title: 让地面强度翻倍的网格
chinese_summary:
这篇文章解释了蜂巢格室——一种三维蜂窝状塑料结构——如何加固软弱土壤，并以长滩港扩建工程作为现实案例。工程师们面对的是无法承受重载的软弱、饱水泥质疏浚淤泥。他们没有开挖并运入昂贵的填料，而是使用蜂巢格室约束土体，将其转变为可供重型设备作业的稳定平台。

文章描述了土壤破坏模式，特别是承载力破坏——即土壤在荷载作用下发生剪切破坏。传统解决方案包括用混凝土基础扩散荷载，或用高质量路基材料替换劣质土，两者成本都很高。土工合成材料提供了替代方案：土工织物起片层作用，土工格栅是与土体互锁的二维网格，而蜂巢格室则是包裹填料的三维结构，能更有效地扩散荷载并减少所需基层厚度。

蜂巢格室还允许使用更廉价或当地的填料，因为塑料结构承担了大部分工作。该技术起源于20世纪70年代的美国陆军工程兵团，甚至曾被考虑用于月球建设。文章中的模型演示表明，蜂巢格室通过约束颗粒并阻止剪切移动，即使在高车速下也能防止松散砂土出现“搓板状”起伏。

在环保方面，蜂巢格室可以减少开挖、缩短运输距离、提高渗透性并减少废弃物，尽管是塑料制品，仍能带来净效益。虽然它并非永远是首选方案，但在道路、边坡、挡土墙和港口设施等岩土工程中占据着宝贵的一席之地。

title: Windows 11's built-in Weather app wastes more than 1 GB of RAM
summary:
Windows 11’s built-in Weather app can consume over 1 GB of RAM, according to tests by Windows Latest and Wccftech. Memory usage started around 1 GB, dropped to 500–600 MB when idle, and could climb to 1.5–1.6 GB during basic actions like zooming or navigating. On an 8 GB system, that can account for nearly 20% of total memory.

The high usage stems from the app not being fully native: it is essentially an MSN Weather web app built on Microsoft’s WebView2 framework, running multiple Chromium-based subprocesses. By comparison, Apple’s macOS Weather app reportedly uses under 250 MB under similar conditions.

The issue mainly affects entry-level PCs with 8–16 GB RAM, potentially increasing reliance on the page file and making the system feel less responsive. The app also embeds sponsored content directly into its forecast feed, drawing criticism for ads in a built-in Windows application.

The findings seem to contradict Microsoft’s stated efforts to improve Windows 11 efficiency on lower-end hardware. Microsoft has said it wants to build more fully native apps in the future, but it remains unclear whether MSN-branded apps like Weather will be rebuilt using WinUI.
chinese_title: Windows 11自带天气应用浪费超1GB内存
chinese_summary:
Windows 11内置的天气应用据Windows Latest和Wccftech测试，其内存占用可超过1 GB。内存使用量起初约为1 GB，空闲时降至500–600 MB，而在缩放或导航等基本操作期间可能攀升至1.5–1.6 GB。在8 GB内存的系统上，这几乎占总内存的20%。

高内存占用源于该应用并非完全原生：它本质上是一个基于微软WebView2框架构建的MSN天气网页应用，运行多个Chromium子进程。相比之下，据报道，Apple的macOS天气应用在类似条件下内存占用不到250 MB。

该问题主要影响配备8–16 GB内存的入门级PC，可能增加对页面文件的依赖，并使系统感觉响应变慢。该应用还将赞助内容直接嵌入其天气预报信息流中，因在Windows内置应用中插入广告而招致批评。

这些发现似乎与微软宣称的提高Windows 11在低端硬件上效率的努力相矛盾。微软曾表示未来希望构建更多完全原生的应用，但尚不清楚天气等MSN品牌应用是否会使用WinUI重建。

title: Silicon Valley misreads science fiction and undermines democracy
summary:
Jill Lepore, a Harvard historian and Pulitzer Prize-winning writer, argues in her upcoming book *The Rise and Fall of the Artificial State* that tech companies are quietly replacing the functions of democratic government, creating what she calls an “artificial state.” She warns this marks “a return to tyranny and mystification” through rule by algorithms, corporations, and machines.

Lepore insists she is not anti-technology; her concern is that private corporations have increasingly taken over state functions without public consent. She traces this shift through technocratic philosophies and science fiction, arguing that many Silicon Valley leaders—especially Elon Musk—misread dystopian or ambivalent sci-fi stories as blueprints for the future.

Key examples include Apple’s famous 1984 Super Bowl ad, which framed the Macintosh as a tool of personal liberation. Lepore says that marketing fantasy later became a “delusional” mindset among figures like Sam Altman, who recently suggested an AI president could be a great idea. She also debunks the “Twitter revolution” myth, noting that Twitter was never a digital town hall: only a small, hyper-partisan slice of Americans dominated political tweets, making it a “distortion machine” rather than a democratic forum.

Lepore highlights the 1996 Telecommunications Act as a pivotal, flawed decision that shaped today’s internet. She also cites E. M. Forster’s 1909 story “The Machine Stops” as an eerily prophetic tale of humans enslaved by a system that provides everything yet strips autonomy. Ultimately, she argues that Silicon Valley’s leaders are taking on the trappings of government while lacking sophisticated political philosophy, and that alternative paths were possible but not taken.
chinese_title: 硅谷误读科幻小说，削弱民主
chinese_summary:
哈佛历史学家、普利策奖得主吉尔·勒波尔在她即将出版的新书《人造国家的兴衰》中指出，科技公司正悄然取代民主政府的职能，打造出一个她所称的“人造国家”。她警告说，这标志着通过算法、企业和机器进行的统治“回归暴政与神秘化”。

勒波尔坚称自己并非反技术；她担心的是，私营企业在未经公众同意的情况下日益接管国家职能。她通过技术官僚哲学和科幻小说追溯了这一转变，认为许多硅谷领袖——尤其是埃隆·马斯克——将反乌托邦或模棱两可的科幻故事误读为未来的蓝图。

典型例子包括苹果公司著名的1984年超级碗广告，该广告将麦金塔电脑塑造成个人解放的工具。勒波尔表示，这种营销幻想后来成为萨姆·奥尔特曼等人“妄想性”的心态，奥尔特曼最近甚至提出AI总统可能是个好主意。她还揭穿了“推特革命”的神话，指出推特从来就不是数字市政厅：只有一小部分高度党派化的美国人在政治推文中占据主导地位，使它成为“扭曲机器”而非民主论坛。

勒波尔强调1996年《电信法》是塑造当今互联网的关键但有缺陷的决策。她还引用E.M.福斯特1909年的小说《机器停转》，认为这是一个诡异而敏锐的预言，描绘了人类被一个提供一切却剥夺自主权的体系所奴役。最终，她认为硅谷领袖正在披上政府的外衣，却缺乏深刻的政治哲学，而其他路径本有可能，却未被选择。

title: My server is a phone now
summary:
The article describes repurposing a CMF Phone 1 (8-core ARM, 8GB RAM, 128GB storage) as a personal server, replacing a paid VPS. Initial attempts to flash postmarketOS failed due to broken drivers (Wi-Fi, GPU, etc.), risking a brick. Recovery restored stock Android, leading to a better approach: keeping Android for hardware support and using Termux as the host environment.

Termux provides SSH, runit for process supervision, Caddy, Cloudflared, and Tailscale. Android boot chain: Tailscale always-on VPN → Termux:Boot → runit → resident services. Battery management is disabled via a wake lock to keep the phone active.

Applications run in Debian filesystems. PRoot (userspace compatibility) worked for most services but was too slow for the latency-sensitive Surf browser (remote Chrome for old iPads). Rooting the phone allowed using native chroot instead, drastically improving performance. OCI images are exported from a workstation, verified by Ansible, and installed into versioned directories with atomic symlinks. Deployments are fully managed via Ansible, with secrets handled through 1Password-signed challenges.

Ingress uses a Cloudflare Tunnel for HTTP services, requiring only outbound connections, so the phone can roam networks. Surf uses a WebSocket-wrapped TLS stream through the tunnel to preserve pinned connections. Tailscale provides stable private access.

Running services include Surf (desktop Chrome streaming to an iPad), a personal finance tracker with off-device backups, a screen-sharing service, and an observability dashboard showing CPU, memory, battery, thermals, and service health.

The author concludes this is practical for personal use if you have a rootable ARM64 phone, but advises against storing irreplaceable data without backups and notes chroots aren't security boundaries. It's a quirky but effective alternative to paying for a VPS.
chinese_title: 我的服务器现在是一部手机
chinese_summary:
这篇文章描述了将一部CMF Phone 1（8核ARM处理器、8GB内存、128GB存储）重新利用为个人服务器，以取代付费VPS的实践。最初尝试刷入postmarketOS失败了，原因是驱动（Wi-Fi、GPU等）不完善，存在变砖风险。恢复原厂Android系统后，采用了一种更好的方案：保留Android以获得硬件支持，并使用Termux作为宿主环境。

Termux提供SSH、runit（用于进程监督）、Caddy、Cloudflared和Tailscale。Android启动链路为：Tailscale常开VPN → Termux:Boot → runit → 常驻服务。通过唤醒锁（wake lock）禁用电池管理，使手机保持活跃状态。

应用程序运行在Debian文件系统中。PRoot（用户态兼容层）可运行大多数服务，但对于对延迟敏感的Surf浏览器（为旧iPad提供远程Chrome服务）来说速度太慢了。对手机进行root后，可以使用原生chroot替代，性能大幅提升。OCI镜像从工作站导出，由Ansible验证，并安装到带原子符号链接的版本化目录中。部署完全通过Ansible管理，密钥通过1Password签名的挑战来处理。

入口流量使用Cloudflare Tunnel代理HTTP服务，只需出站连接，因此手机可以在不同网络间漫游。Surf通过隧道使用WebSocket包装的TLS流来保持固定连接。Tailscale提供稳定的私有访问。

正在运行的服务包括Surf（桌面Chrome流式传输到iPad）、个人理财追踪器（带设备外备份）、屏幕共享服务，以及显示CPU、内存、电池、热状态和服务健康的可观测性仪表盘。

作者总结道，如果你有一部可root的ARM64手机，这种方案对个人使用是可行的，但建议不要在没有备份的情况下存储不可替代的数据，并指出chroot不是安全边界。这是付费VPS之外一个另类但有效的替代方案。

title: TheoremDB – A public workspace for machine mathematics
summary:
The article introduces **TheoremDB**, a public workspace for machine mathematics, and highlights an open mathematical problem hosted there.

The featured problem, **#P2692**, concerns a sharp \(L^2\) norm estimate for the centered maximal operator on the cyclic group \(\mathbb Z/31\mathbb Z\). For a function \(f:\mathbb Z/31\mathbb Z\to\mathbb R\), the operator is defined by

\[
Mf(j)=\max_{0\leq r\leq15}\frac{1}{2r+1}\sum_{k=-r}^{r}|f(j+k)|.
\]

The goal is to determine the exact operator norm:

\[
\sup_{f\neq 0}\frac{\|Mf\|_2}{\|f\|_2}.
\]

The problem is currently marked **Open**, and it is categorized under **harmonic analysis**. The entry also appears as an "Open packet" with an option to "Open in ChatGPT," indicating TheoremDB is designed for interactive collaboration between human mathematicians and machine learning tools.

title: Should you stop cracking your knuckles?
summary:
Cracking knuckles is a common habit, but is it harmful? The article explains the science and evidence.

The popping sound occurs when joints are stretched, expanding the joint space and lowering pressure in the synovial fluid. This causes dissolved gases to form bubbles, which collapse, creating the "crack" — a sound up to 83 decibels, similar to a diesel truck.

Research indicates knuckle cracking is mostly harmless. A famous 50-year self-experiment by Donald Unger found no arthritis difference between cracked and uncracked hands. Multiple studies confirm no link between knuckle cracking and osteoarthritis. Examinations of habitual crackers found no swelling or disability.

However, forceful cracking can rarely cause sprains or dislocations. Neck cracking is riskier, as the neck contains the spinal cord and vital arteries. Excessive manipulation can cause serious injury, and professional chiropractic neck adjustments have been called "unnecessary and inadvisable."

Claims about weakened grip are conflicting: a 1990 study found weaker grips and swelling, but a 2017 study found no correlation. Myths about big knuckles or loose tendons are untrue. Cracking may provide relief and temporary mobility by stretching joints and possibly releasing endorphins.

Overall, knuckle cracking is harmless to joints — the only potential harm may be annoying others. To quit, experts suggest cognitive therapy, tracking triggers, and using stress balls or fidget toys. The article provides general information only, not medical advice.
chinese_title: 该不该掰手指？
chinese_summary:
掰手指是一种常见习惯，但它有害吗？文章解释了其科学原理和证据。

爆裂声发生在关节被拉伸时，关节间隙扩大，滑液压力降低。这导致溶解的气体形成气泡，气泡破裂产生“咔哒”声——声音可达83分贝，类似于柴油卡车。

研究表明，掰手指大多无害。Donald Unger著名的50年自我实验发现，掰过和未掰过的手指之间没有关节炎差异。多项研究证实掰手指与骨关节炎无关。对习惯性掰手指者的检查未发现肿胀或功能障碍。

然而，用力过猛很少会导致扭伤或脱位。掰脖子风险更大，因为颈部包含脊髓和重要动脉。过度操作可导致严重损伤，专业的脊椎按摩颈部调整被称为“不必要且不可取”。

关于握力减弱的说法存在矛盾：1990年的一项研究发现握力减弱和肿胀，但2017年的一项研究未发现相关性。关于指关节变大或肌腱松弛的传言并不属实。掰手指可能通过拉伸关节和可能释放内啡肽来提供缓解和暂时的活动度。

总体而言，掰手指对关节无害——唯一潜在的坏处可能是惹恼别人。要戒掉这个习惯，专家建议认知疗法、记录触发因素，并使用压力球或解压玩具。本文仅提供一般信息，不构成医疗建议。

title: We replaced Redis with MySQL for inventory reservations and it scaled
summary:
Shopify replaced Redis with MySQL for inventory reservations to fix consistency issues and support scale. Previously, reservations lived in Redis while the inventory ledger was in MySQL, making atomic reserve/claim operations impossible and risking overselling or underselling.

The new solution uses MySQL's `SKIP LOCKED` feature with one row per sellable unit, grouped into bounded pools capped at 1,000 rows per item/location to keep queries fast. If the pool empties, a guarded inline replenishment runs while other transactions wait.

Key technical decisions:
- **Composite primary key** (shop_id, inventory_item_id, inventory_group_id, id) instead of auto-increment, reducing lock count from two per row to one.
- **READ COMMITTED** isolation to avoid gap locks that blocked replenishment.
- **Consistent lock ordering** (reserve deletes from units before inserting into reserved_quantities) to prevent deadlocks between reserve and claim.
- **UNION ALL batching** to cut round trips for multi-line-item carts.

The real bottleneck wasn't queries or CPU—it was connection exhaustion. The team added SQL comment tags (`/* conn_tag:... */`) per business process and aggregated hold times at the ProxySQL layer. This revealed that other checkout-path code was holding connections too long. Cleanup cut primary-database reads by 50% and transactions by 33%. They also increased InnoDB thread concurrency, which had been set conservatively years earlier.

The cutover used shadow mode: both Redis and MySQL received writes, MySQL was validated against production traffic, then gradually became the source of truth with a kill-switch for rollback.

Takeaways: revisit old decisions and configuration assumptions; start with a minimal prototype and observe behavior directly. The goal wasn't just fast reservations—it was making them safe neighbors that don't degrade database health for the rest of the checkout flow.
chinese_title: 我们用MySQL替换了Redis用于库存预留，并且它扩展得很好。
chinese_summary:
Shopify 用 MySQL 替换了 Redis 用于库存预留，以解决一致性问题并支撑规模扩展。此前，预留数据保存在 Redis 中，而库存账本在 MySQL 中，这使得原子化的预留/认领操作无法实现，并存在超卖或少卖的风险。

新方案利用 MySQL 的 `SKIP LOCKED` 特性，为每个可售单元分配一行，并将其归入有界池，每个商品/位置最多 1000 行，以保证查询速度。如果池被清空，则在其他事务等待时执行受保护的内联补充。

关键技术决策：
- **复合主键**（shop_id、inventory_item_id、inventory_group_id、id）替代自增主键，每行的锁数量从两把降为一把。
- **READ COMMITTED** 隔离级别，避免阻塞补充操作的间隙锁。
- **一致的锁顺序**（预留时先从 units 中删除，再插入 reserved_quantities），避免预留与认领之间的死锁。
- **UNION ALL 批量处理**，减少多行项目购物车的往返通信次数。

真正的瓶颈不在于查询或 CPU，而在于连接耗尽。团队为每个业务流程添加了 SQL 注释标签（`/* conn_tag:... */`），并在 ProxySQL 层汇总了连接持有时间。这一做法揭示了结账路径上的其他代码持有连接时间过长。清理后，主数据库读取量减少了 50%，事务量减少了 33%。他们还提高了 InnoDB 线程并发度，该参数多年前被设置得过于保守。

切换采用了影子模式：Redis 和 MySQL 同时接收写入，MySQL 针对生产流量进行验证，然后逐步成为事实来源，并配有用于回滚的熔断开关。

经验教训：重新审视旧的决策和配置假设；从最小原型开始，直接观察行为。目标不仅仅是让预留更快，而是让它们成为安全的邻居，不会损害结账流程其余部分的数据库健康状况。

title: Os8088: A powerful Mac-like OS for the IBM XT, 286, 386
summary:
os8088 is a hobby graphical operating system for the original IBM PC/XT, written entirely in real-mode assembly for the Intel 8086 and booted from a floppy. It recreates a Macintosh System 1-style desktop—overlapping windows, pull-down menus, a serial mouse, a dock, and loadable applications—while adding pre-emptive multitasking, which the 1984 Mac lacked.

The system fits in 256K of RAM and runs on 8086/8088 processors. It probes and supports VGA (640x480, 16 colors), Hercules (720x348 mono), and CGA (640x200 mono). The kernel is 80,486 bytes; the boot sector is exactly 512 bytes. It provides 12 pre-emptive task slots with 1,536-byte stacks, switching at the PC timer rate of 18.2065 Hz. Programs load from a second floppy into their own memory segments; examples include Minesweeper (1,510 bytes), Note Pad, Paint, Solitaire, and a MOD player.

The article notes historical context: Digital Research's GEM 1.0 brought a Mac-like GUI to the PC in 1985, but Apple’s lawsuit led to the removal of overlapping windows and icons—os8088 rebuilds that idea with more advanced multitasking. It is not DOS, has no memory protection, no networking, and no file handles, but is complete enough to use. It has been tested on real hardware, including an IBM 5150, and can be tried in a browser or downloaded as floppy images for emulators or period machines. Source code is on GitHub.
chinese_title: Os8088：面向IBM XT、286、386的强大类Mac操作系统
chinese_summary:
os8088 是一个面向原始 IBM PC/XT 的业余图形操作系统，完全用 Intel 8086 的实模式汇编语言编写，从软盘启动。它重现了 Macintosh System 1 风格的桌面——重叠窗口、下拉菜单、串口鼠标、程序坞和可加载应用程序——同时增加了抢占式多任务处理，而这是 1984 年的 Mac 所不具备的。

该系统只需 256K 内存即可运行，可在 8086/8088 处理器上运行。它检测并支持 VGA（640x480，16 色）、Hercules（720x348 单色）和 CGA（640x200 单色）。内核大小为 80,486 字节；引导扇区正好是 512 字节。它提供 12 个抢占式任务槽，每个槽带 1,536 字节的栈，以 PC 定时器速率 18.2065 Hz 切换任务。程序从第二张软盘加载到各自的内存段；示例包括扫雷（1,510 字节）、记事本、画图、纸牌和一个 MOD 播放器。

文章提到了历史背景：Digital Research 的 GEM 1.0 于 1985 年将类似 Mac 的 GUI 带到了 PC 上，但 Apple 的诉讼导致其移除了重叠窗口和图标——os8088 以更先进的多任务处理重建了这一理念。它不是 DOS，没有内存保护、没有网络功能、也没有文件句柄，但已足够完整可用。它已在真实硬件（包括 IBM 5150）上测试过，并且可以在浏览器中试用，或下载软盘镜像用于模拟器或那个时代的机器。源代码在 GitHub 上。

title: The original URL for this prediction will no longer be available in 11 years (2011)
summary:
Long Bet #601, running from 2011 to 2022, asked whether the original URL for the prediction—`www.longbets.org/601`—would still be available after 11 years.

- **Predictor:** Jeremy Keith argued that link rot is the “entropy of the web,” and even a relatively short period like 11 years is too long for a web document to survive in its original location.
- **Challenger:** Matthew A. Haughey argued that web technologies and strategies have matured, and stable URL systems are achievable. He noted his own oldest sites had survived 13 years, with the original URL scheme still functioning via 301 redirects.

**Stakes:** $1,000 would go to Bletchley Park Trust if Keith won, or The Internet Archive if Haughey won.

**Detailed terms:** On February 22, 2022, from 00:01 UTC to 23:59 UTC, entering `http://www.longbets.org/601` in a browser or command-line tool—or following a hyperlink to that URL—must return an HTML document containing the exact text: “The original URL for this prediction (www.longbets.org/601) will no longer be available in eleven years.” A 301 redirect to a different URL containing that text would also count. If those conditions were met, Haughey would win; otherwise, Keith would win.

The page also includes standard Long Bets navigation elements, comments via Disqus, and a request to enable JavaScript to view them.

- **挑战者：** Matthew A. Haughey认为，网络技术和策略已经成熟，稳定的URL系统是可以实现的。他指出，自己最早的网站已存续13年，原始URL方案仍通过301重定向正常运作。

title: Fastmail offers EU data region
summary:
Fastmail now offers EU data residency for user accounts, with primary data stored on its own servers in Amsterdam. Previously, all accounts were US-based. Users can choose between EU and US regions.

Key details:

- **EU region:** Primary data lives in Amsterdam. Incoming mail and app connections prefer EU servers, with automatic fallback to US locations if Amsterdam is unavailable. A resilient replica of data is kept in the US because there is only one EU site.
- **US region:** Primary and replica data both stay in Philadelphia or St Louis, with fallback between those US sites.
- **All users:** Emergency backups are stored in Philadelphia. Some metadata (email addresses, user/customer data, attached services, Files feature, website storage) is replicated to all sites. System logs are consolidated in the US. Third-party services for debugging, billing, and support are shared regardless of region.
- **Compliance:** Fastmail is an Australian company and will respond to lawful requests from relevant authorities. They state clearly they cannot guarantee data remains only in the EU.
- **Migration:** Users with European billing addresses were pre-selected and had encrypted data copied to Europe in advance. Others can request migration, which takes longer because data must be synced across the ocean. Region can be switched in Settings → Users & Sharing → Team Settings under Data residency.
- **No surcharge:** Fastmail does not charge extra for choosing the EU region.

The company emphasizes transparency, noting that most providers decide for users, while Fastmail lets them choose with full information.
chinese_title: Fastmail 提供欧盟数据区域
chinese_summary:
Fastmail 现为用户的账户提供欧盟数据驻留选项，主要数据存储在其位于阿姆斯特丹的自有服务器上。此前，所有账户均位于美国。用户现在可以在欧盟和美国区域之间进行选择。

关键细节：

- **欧盟区域：** 主要数据存储于阿姆斯特丹。接收邮件和应用连接优先使用欧盟服务器，若阿姆斯特丹不可用，则自动回退至美国位置。由于欧盟仅有一个站点，数据会在美国保留一份弹性副本。
- **美国区域：** 主要数据和副本数据均留在费城或圣路易斯，并在这些美国站点之间进行回退。
- **所有用户：** 紧急备份存储在费城。部分元数据（电子邮件地址、用户/客户数据、附加服务、文件功能、网站存储）会复制到所有站点。系统日志汇总在美国。无论区域如何，调试、计费和支持所用的第三方服务均为共享。
- **合规性：** Fastmail 是一家澳大利亚公司，将回应相关当局的合法请求。他们明确表示，无法保证数据仅留在欧盟。
- **迁移：** 账单地址为欧洲的用户已提前被预选，其加密数据已预先复制到欧洲。其他用户可申请迁移，但由于数据需要跨洋同步，耗时更长。可在“设置 → 用户与共享 → 团队设置”中的“数据驻留”选项下切换区域。
- **无额外费用：** Fastmail 不因选择欧盟区域而额外收费。

该公司强调透明度，并指出大多数提供商替用户做决定，而 Fastmail 则让用户在充分了解信息的情况下自行选择。

title: NoRecognition: AI Adversarial Clothing
summary:
**NoRecognition** is an exclusive, limited-release line of AI adversarial clothing designed to make wearers undetectable by computer vision cameras. Coming from a year of research presented at Black Hat and DEF CON, the drop is announced with a countdown and currently live on Kickstarter, with notifications offered for early access.

The collection includes:
- **Tee**: Everyday torso coverage.
- **Hoodie**: Maximum body coverage.
- **Buff**: A multi-use neck gaiter/headband.
- **One of One**: A unique pattern generated and validated for a single person, never publicly released.

Only 50 of each item are made, produced to order with no restocks. The brand distinguishes itself from other "anti-surveillance" clothing by publishing test results. Patterns are scored against eleven production computer vision models (including vehicle and person detectors used on many US streets). They must beat a plain control panel of the same size, are evaluated on 30 held-out test wearers, and both positive and negative results are disclosed. Key statistics include 31.7 million tests run, 11 production models tested, 5.7 million labeled results, and one year of research. The patterns themselves remain private and are never released or printed before shipping. Backers get first access before limited tiers sell out.
chinese_title: NoRecognition：AI对抗服饰
chinese_summary:
**NoRecognition** 是一个独家限量发布的AI对抗性服装系列，旨在让穿着者无法被计算机视觉摄像头检测到。该系列源于在Black Hat和DEF CON上展示的一年研究成果，此次发布以倒计时形式宣布，目前已在Kickstarter上线，并提供通知以获取抢先体验。
